detail.longDescription: From the time of CSS Zen Garden, I have been deeply impressed, and often intimidated and overwhelmed, by the capabilities of CSS. It's been a few years since the last time I used the technology, which had advanced exponentially in complexity, functionality, and capabilities from when I'd used it previously, and I was truly amazed at how much could be done in pure CSS that had once required at least one, or more, additional technologies. # CSS is # programming .
